crossRefs.note: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if…
but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come…
Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he…
The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand…
Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he has purposed against…
Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he has purposed against…

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

translations.web: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.
translations.bsb: But a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull.
translations.kjv: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
translations.asv: And a certain woman cast an upper millstone upon Abimelech's head, and brake his skull.
